_about: Bird plates cut for this site from public-domain scans, in Fugleramme's classic style, with
Fugleramme's tools/platereview (plate.py, finish.py). Keyed by BirdNET+ V3's scientific name.
fetch_bird_plates.py credits these instead of listing the bird as without a plate.
To re-cut one: download scan_file, write spec (plus "scan": <file>) to <work>/spec.json, run
plate.py crop, plate.py cut, finish.py cut.png final.png, then save final.png as
website/art/birds/<slug>.webp with the longest side 480 px, WebP quality 86.

Orthonyx temminckii.name: Australian Logrunner
Orthonyx temminckii.work: Jean-Gabriel Prêtre, in Temminck & Laugier, Nouveau recueil de planches coloriées d'oiseaux, plate 428 (1820s)
Orthonyx temminckii.scan_note: Musée cantonal de zoologie, Lausanne copy, digitised by the Biodiversity Heritage Library; public domain
Orthonyx temminckii.cut: 2026-11-24, Fugleramme plate-review tools at a7848e0 (plate.py cut, finish.py): paper balanced to the halo tone, paper between tail, legs and log toned to the page. Chosen over Gould's plate, whose painted landscape does not cut cleanly. The plate calls this orange-throated bird the male; it is the female.
